row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote-only; LearnUpon for Employees from 100 users)
row.evidence: LearnUpon's help centre says SCIM 2.0 lets your IdP "create, read, update and deactivate accounts in LearnUpon", with "Availability: depends on your LearnUpon plan"; the pricing page publishes no prices, only Book a Demo per solution.
row.notes: Quote-only: LearnUpon sells three solutions (Employees from 100 users, Customer Education from 300, Associations from 150) with no list prices. SAML SSO is available to all customers and listed for all three solutions; SCIM is plan-dependent and needs the LearnUpon API and SAML SSO turned on. SCIM base URL https://{portal}.learnupon.com/api/v1/scim/ with Basic auth (API key and password) or OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens (up to 1-year expiry, needed for Entra). SCIM group push added September 2026 (groups must pre-exist; displayName eq filter only). Okta OIN and Entra gallery apps are SAML SSO only (Entra lists JIT); customers use a custom SCIM app. REST API (Basic auth) has user CRUD, groups, group memberships and an audit-trails endpoint. min_seats 100 is the 'From 100 Users' figure for LearnUpon for Employees.

plans.name: LearnUpon for Employees
plans.notes: Pricing table marks SSO and Two-way API Access for all three solutions (read from page markup).

auth.token_source: Basic auth with the portal API key and password (Settings > Integrations > API Keys), or an OAuth 2.0 app for bearer tokens

operations.notes: Docs say create, read, update and deactivate; PUT vs PATCH not stated. Group push only fills existing LearnUpon groups (does not create them).

deprovision.notes: login_enabled is a SCIM-updatable parameter; docs do not describe the effect beyond 'deactivate'.

custom.how: IdP custom attributes in the enterprise extension namespace mapped to LearnUpon custom user data under Settings > Integrations > SAML SSO > SCIM settings

attributes.notes: Docs list LearnUpon parameters (first_name, last_name, display_name, username, email, login_enabled, portal_membership_type) rather than SCIM attribute paths.

roles.how: userType mapped to LearnUpon user types admin, member, manager, instructor

limitations.text: One-way provisioning only: accounts created in LearnUpon are not exported to the IdP.
SCIM group sync does not create groups; groups must exist in LearnUpon with SAML group sync enabled.
Group filter supports only displayName eq "Group Name".

scim.notes: SCIM is set up per portal (top-level and sub-portals). Group sync page says 'Availability: all customers' for the group feature once user SCIM is in place.

rate_limits.text: Aim for no more than 5 requests per second in bursts; limits are per portal and returned in response headers.

user_api.notes: Endpoint paths are relative to /api/v1 as listed in the API guide's method tables. Role set via user_type on create/update. login_enabled toggles login (filter documented on list).

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated 2018) marks SAML only (read from page markup); LearnUpon documents SCIM with Okta via a custom SCIM app.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SSO with JIT; no provisioning tutorial. LearnUpon says custom Entra SCIM integrations need 1-year tokens.

onelogin.notes: LearnUpon names OneLogin among IdPs that provision over SCIM 2.0; OneLogin catalogue not checked (blocks bots).

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML group sync at login; SFTP batch user upload; HRIS integrations
